title: Party pages: the button in the card, the logo in the corner, a blurred backdrop
why: Critic on 46, 55 and 56: Press any button hangs outside the card, the wordmark floats off the card edge, and the hub behind the card stays legible (labels, HUD). The button is the card footer now, the wordmark the logo on the top left margin, the run over card the 720px end card width, and the backdrop blurs what is behind it. Restyle only.
now: The party pages have the button inside the card and a soft backdrop.
